rule: δ-SNLI dev+test merged (line = 0-based line in data/defeasible-snli/<split>.jsonl). Drop rows with UpdateTypeImpossible==true; group remaining rows by exact (Premise, Hypothesis); keep pairs with >=1 strengthener and >=1 weakener. Cluster = image = SNLIPairId before '#'. Drop pairs whose image is among the snli images of read20_ids.json or the images of human20_images.json. Sort keys by (Premise, Hypothesis); rng = random.Random(20261070); rng.shuffle(keys); walk and keep a pair only if its image is not yet taken, until 150 pairs; first 30 = dev, next 120 = formal. In that order, for each pair rng.choice(S rows sorted by (split, line)) then rng.choice(W rows sorted by (split, line)). Repeat subset = random.Random(20261071).sample(sorted formal keys, 20). Key = SNLIPairId.
